--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_cli_encoding_option.py
@@ -0,0 +1,53 @@
+import json
+
+import pytest
+
+from click.testing import CliRunner
+
+import dotenv.cli as cli_module
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("command", ["list", "get", "set", "unset", "run"])
+def test_cli_latin1_all_commands(tmp_path, monkeypatch, command):
+    path = tmp_path / ".env"
+    path.write_bytes("NAME=café\nREF=${NAME}\nBARE\n".encode("latin-1"))
+    captured = {}
+
+    def capture(commandline, env):
+        captured.update(env)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(cli_module, "run_command", capture)
+    tail = {
+        "list": ["list", "--format", "json"],
+        "get": ["get", "REF"],
+        "set": ["set", "NAME", "déjà"],
+        "unset": ["unset", "NAME"],
+        "run": ["run", "unused-command"],
+    }[command]
+    result = CliRunner().invoke(
+        cli_module.cli,
+        ["--file", str(path), "--encoding", "latin-1", *tail],
+    )
+    assert result.exit_code == 0, result.output
+    if command == "list":
+        assert json.loads(result.output) == {"NAME": "café", "REF": "café", "BARE": None}
+    elif command == "get":
+        assert result.output == "café\n"
+    elif command == "set":
+        assert result.output == "NAME=déjà\n"
+        assert path.read_bytes() == "NAME='déjà'\nREF=${NAME}\nBARE\n".encode("latin-1")
+    elif command == "unset":
+        assert result.output == "Successfully removed NAME\n"
+        assert path.read_bytes() == b"REF=${NAME}\nBARE\n"
+    else:
+        assert captured == {"NAME": "café", "REF": "café"}
+
+
+def test_cli_encoding_default_utf8(tmp_path):
+    path = tmp_path / ".env"
+    path.write_bytes("NAME=雪\n".encode("utf-8"))
+    result = CliRunner().invoke(
+        cli_module.cli, ["--file", str(path), "get", "NAME"]
+    )
+    assert result.exit_code == 0, result.output
+    assert result.output == "雪\n"

spec.question: Add a global `--encoding` option to the dotenv CLI, defaulting to `utf-8`. It must control decoding for `list`, `get`, and `run`, and both reading and writing for `set` and `unset`. Commands must continue to display decoded Unicode values normally, and interpolation, quote/export options, override behavior, and existing error statuses must remain unchanged. The option belongs before the subcommand, alongside `--file`; do not change the public library API signatures. Deliver a unified diff against production files only.
